mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns despite low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) in more than 40% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) crosses above 5%, it indicates monetary tightening, which can lead to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 5% over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) coupled with high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a squeeze on consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity and supply chain health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns despite industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100) in more than 30% of cases over a 4-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates reduced demand in the housing market, which can lead to broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases when HOUST < 1200 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, which typically leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns despite payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 150000) in more than 40% of cases over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 30% of cases when both GDPC1 growth slows and UNRATE rises over a 4-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates reduced consumer spending, which can lead to broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases when RSAFS < 700000 over a 3-year period.
